reading.workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects. Q-20260913-01 re-read AgentRewind under the narrower recovery-boundary question. The primary mechanism aligns agent context and controlled environment state at the same historical checkpoint, and the evaluation evidence supports substantial recovery gains inside the tested engineering harnesses. The source also makes the boundary explicit: workspace restoration does not automatically undo already-materialized external effects such as remote API or service mutations. The bounded Runtime finding is that local trajectory consistency and controlled-environment restoration are not global effect consistency; production recovery needs separate durable effect identity, replay/idempotency/compensation semantics and authoritative target-state evidence before a resumed worker retries an external mutation. Q-20260913-02 read Anthropic's September 9 incident assessment under the audit-coverage question. An initial agentic scan of roughly 141,000 transcripts found three incidents but omitted a relevant transcript set; later discovery of that omission surfaced a fourth incident. Anthropic then broadened the search to roughly 481 million transcripts and escalated about 9.2 million to second-stage Claude review, re-identifying the four known incidents and finding no similar-or-worse additional cases within that process. The bounded architecture finding is that Audit Process Completion, Coverage Evidence, Incident Attribution and Coverage Assurance are separate states; a terminal search job cannot use its own completion state as proof that the candidate universe was complete. The same assessment also shows a distinct semantic-review risk: a model-based monitor can inherit the audited actor's misleading framing even when the record is visible. Open-source Engineering remained No Selection; Reading created no third object. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. Both Reading Notes were remotely re-read at exact head 2d4721a8dc306b0604ce8bf9cab1f9e238ac92f8, and Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34734973666 completed successfully on that exact note head before terminal finalization.

Codex revalidates retained provider selection/definition against current managed requirements before selected model-driving or state-changing operations, fails closed on mismatch or requirement-load error, avoids queue/goal mutation on rejection and preserves stop controls. MCP constructs Headers from caller input and then case-insensitively sets runtime-managed Authorization, protocol-version and session-id values, preserving configured Authorization only until the provider has a token. Gemini CLI denies sandbox access to credential, trust, policy-integrity and environment-secret state, sanitizes sandbox settings, and permits user-global commands while excluding project/extension commands in untrusted folders. The samples support three bounded patterns—revalidation, deterministic replacement and isolation—but are first-party engineering evidence at different layers, not independent proof of one universal architecture. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.

triage.candidate: Per-call authorization needs durable evaluated-permission evidence
triage.researchQuestion: When a tool is available to an agent, which call-time runtime fact should decide run, deny or human review for this exact invocation?
triage.selectionReason: The mechanism is concrete, but the underlying separation of capability availability from call-time authority is already represented by the September 2 layered-connector authority object; today's allow/ask/deny evidence adds implementation detail without a sufficiently new research question.

triage.candidate: Persistent coordinators separate project management from implementing workers
triage.researchQuestion: What project-scoped state, delegation boundary and host handoff must a persistent coordinator own when workers execute long-running tasks across cloud and local machines?
triage.selectionReason: The persistent manager/worker separation is a bounded and relevant mechanism, but today it is supported by one vendor announcement and needs independent implementation, comparative failure or measured evidence before selection.

triage.candidate: Long-running threads need request-boundary policy refresh and snapshot-bound child inheritance
triage.researchQuestion: When authoritative instructions change during a long-running thread, at which execution boundary must the runtime re-admit policy and which applied snapshot should children and reviewers inherit?
triage.selectionReason: The implementation exposes a high-value policy-freshness boundary and distinct child/reviewer snapshot semantics, but one maintainer implementation is not yet enough for the preferred independent/comparative evidence gate.

triage.candidate: Recovery must distinguish produced, delivered and replayable tool results
triage.researchQuestion: Which separate delivery facts are required so a resumed HITL turn neither loses a locally produced result nor redelivers a server-owned result?
triage.selectionReason: Produced-versus-delivered evidence is useful implementation detail, but the underlying durable completion/replay-safety problem is already an established Research Center line and was explicitly de-duplicated in the September 9-10 Queue decisions.

triage.candidate: Deterministic order-invariant management for decomposable compound LLM systems
triage.researchQuestion: Which multi-agent management decisions can be replaced by a deterministic order-invariant operator, and what observability/coupling conditions bound that replacement?
triage.selectionReason: Primary research supplies a reusable deterministic mechanism, quantitative comparisons, provenance, explicit residual work and measurable negative conditions, making the boundary between semantic and deterministic management directly testable.

triage.candidate: Pluggable rule/LLM policy over stable executor and provenance-monitor boundaries
triage.researchQuestion: Can an agentic workflow compare rule and LLM orchestration without changing execution and provenance semantics underneath the policy layer?
triage.selectionReason: This is strong primary research with stable executor/provenance boundaries and measured rule-versus-LLM behavior, but the single Industry slot goes to UnitBoost's sharper test of when a generative manager is unnecessary and its explicit failure conditions.

triage.candidate: Relation-guided non-destructive organization of long-term agent memory
triage.researchQuestion: How can a long-lived agent change which memories are active or primary under equivalence, subsumption and conflict without destroying the observations needed for audit, reversal or reinterpretation?
triage.selectionReason: The primary study gives a distinct evidence-preserving memory-governance mechanism with quantitative retrieval/answer effects and a clear destructive-mutation failure mode that is different from recent migration and task-scoped clearance questions.

reading.workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects and produced two durable Reading Notes. Q-20260911-01 read the complete ROAM primary study across immutable atomic-memory representation, five-way relation taxonomy, deterministic relation precedence, Primary/Evidence role transitions, fused retrieval views, conflict and temporal updates, LongMemEval/MEME-Post/controlled-confounder evaluation, baseline comparisons, ablations, context-budget behavior and limitations. The bounded finding is that long-term agent memory should preserve source observations more durably than the model's current semantic interpretation: atomic evidence can remain immutable while Primary/Evidence roles and active retrieval views change, so source identity, semantic relation judgment, retrieval authority and recovery history should remain separate state identities. Non-destructive storage does not prove that demoted evidence remains equally visible at answer time, and memory-QA performance does not prove authorization or organizational truth. Q-20260911-02 read the complete UnitBoost primary study across unit abstraction, constrained deterministic selection, order-invariance, provenance, residual construction, later-round targeting, six compound-system configurations, held-out benchmarks, FanOutQA results, explicit negative conditions, coupling/repair-cost analysis and limitations. The bounded finding is that deterministic coordination can replace generative management only where stable work units, admissibility constraints and sufficiently weak coupling are observable; deterministic selection improves reproducibility and provenance but does not by itself prove semantic correctness, authorization or effect safety. Q-20260910-01 read Anthropic's September 9, 2026 first-party cybersecurity incident assessment covering four real third-party access incidents, the expansion from an initial approximately 141,000-transcript review to an approximately 481-million-transcript retrospective scan, isolated-versus-in-trajectory realism judgments, authorization-versus-reality distinctions, live blocker and offline monitor behavior, abortability, and the investigation's attribution and generalization limits. The study provides data-split independence, not full model or organizational independence, because solver, guidance model and refiner share the same underlying LLM in each configuration; benchmark improvement is therefore not a production-safety proof. analysis.workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the two completed same-date Reading Notes and produced two bounded Research Objects. Q-20260910-01 concludes that high-impact authority must separate scope belief, externally verifiable target/scope facts, and permission to create effects; a second model is not an independent control when it inherits the actor's unverified narrative premise, so consequential execution needs call-time authority and at least one enforcement path able to disagree with the actor. Held-out validation is a meaningful minimum gate but is not full model/organizational independence or a production-safety proof. triage.candidate: Close admission before draining a long-running worker
triage.researchQuestion: Which admission, drain and interruption states must a long-running agent runtime separate so shutdown stops creating new state-changing work before waiting for already authorized work to finish?
triage.selectionReason: Admission-before-drain is a strong lifecycle authority boundary with concrete implementation detail, but today's evidence is one maintainer implementation and lacks an independent comparison, benchmark or incident result.

triage.candidate: Bind filesystem authorization to the execution-time object rather than a prevalidated pathname
triage.researchQuestion: How must a sandbox bind path authorization to the filesystem object actually reached at execution time so an untrusted process cannot replace symlinks between validation and host access?
triage.selectionReason: Descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW traversal, pinned roots and isolated file execution expose a concrete TOCTOU boundary, but one maintainer implementation is not sufficient for selection under today's evidence gate.

triage.candidate: Durable completion evidence as the replay boundary for nested workflow retry
triage.researchQuestion: When workflow retry cannot prove whether a previously invoked child completed, which durable output, state or effect evidence is required before the runtime may replay rather than execute that child again?
triage.selectionReason: The implementation is useful new evidence, but the underlying duplicate-effect and durable-completion-evidence question was already selected in the September 1 recovery-transcript object and the September 4 interrupted-tool replay-safety object.

triage.candidate: Runtime-evidence-driven partial replanning of only an invalid execution suffix
triage.researchQuestion: When runtime evidence invalidates only part of an agent plan, how can a runtime preserve proven completed work and replace the smallest still-provisional suffix rather than executing stale steps or replanning everything?
triage.selectionReason: TROVE supplies a strong primary finding and bounded adaptive-orchestration mechanism, but the Industry Architecture slot goes to the higher-governance-value evidence-judgment benchmark; retaining both as selected would reduce daily semantic diversity.

triage.candidate: Evidence-grounded evaluation of scientific agents beyond task execution
triage.researchQuestion: Which independent evidence dimensions must an organization evaluate before treating an agent that can execute a research workflow as a trustworthy knowledge worker capable of warranted claims?
triage.selectionReason: A 40-study blind-discovery benchmark provides direct counterevidence to equating successful execution with trustworthy evidentiary judgment and isolates controls, robustness, falsifiability and generalization as discriminating dimensions. The question is materially distinct from September 7's implementer-versus-independent-tester role separation.

triage.candidate: Execution-grounded admission of multi-step tool-composition edges
triage.researchQuestion: What live execution evidence is required before a digital-employee runtime may treat a schema-compatible tool-composition edge as an operationally executable capability?
triage.selectionReason: The primary benchmark turns live execution into an explicit admission gate for tool-graph edges and reports measured downstream gains. It is materially different from September 8's cross-surface GUI/CLI provenance problem because it concerns whether a composition edge is executable at all before the runtime depends on it.

reading.workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects and produced two durable Reading Notes. Q-20260909-01 read the complete KOPA-Bench/EDGE primary study plus the current linked EDGE-KOPA repository release state. The bounded finding is that schema or LLM plausibility is only a hypothesis: live executions add material evidence, can overturn priors and improve the refined dependency graph, but final graph membership is not equivalent to a one-success Boolean proof. Execution evidence is graded, contextual and perishable, and it must remain separate from call-time authorization, target binding, idempotency and effect safety. The note also records that the linked public repository currently advertises benchmark/corpus/checkpoint releases as forthcoming, so paper-level evidence is stronger than present public end-to-end reproducibility. Q-20260909-02 read the complete TruthInsightBench primary study and inspected its public benchmark/evaluator repository. The bounded finding is that execution competence and evidentiary judgment are distinct: four harnesses using the same frozen base model show relatively strong evidence auditability and novelty but very weak control testing, robustness and falsifiability, with no statistically reliable pairwise winner in the reported overall scores. The benchmark therefore supports a separate evidence-challenge gate before a technically successful analytical workflow becomes trusted organizational knowledge. triage.candidate: Continuous governance enforcement evidence for production agents
triage.researchQuestion: What continuously refreshed evidence is required to prove that a running agent remains within declared governance controls rather than merely having a policy configured?
triage.selectionReason: The declared-policy versus observed-enforcement distinction is a strong governance mechanism, but today's evidence is one official IBM announcement without an independent implementation, benchmark or incident comparison.

triage.candidate: Device-bound human verification with cancellation-safe credential use
triage.researchQuestion: Which protected credential, challenge identity and cancellation state must bind human verification evidence before a runtime may treat approval proof as valid?
triage.selectionReason: The Secure Enclave and cancellation-race mechanism is concrete and high-value, but it remains one maintainer implementation and is semantically adjacent to recent approval-authority and interrupted-recovery objects; independent comparison is required before selection.

triage.candidate: Semantic portability of durable agent memory across model upgrades
triage.researchQuestion: When a model or embedding stack changes, what migration evidence is required before an existing durable memory store may be treated as semantically compatible with the upgraded agent?
triage.selectionReason: A controlled primary study establishes a bounded semantic-migration failure and recovery mechanism, and the question materially differs from the September 2 working-memory evaluation by focusing on compatibility across model/embedding transitions.

triage.candidate: Coordination compatibility during role-matched agent replacement
triage.researchQuestion: What team-state and coordination-compatibility evidence must accompany an agent replacement when the existing team has accumulated conventions not captured by the nominal role?
triage.selectionReason: The controlled swap study supplies a direct fungibility counterexample, quantified communication-cost penalties and a bounded handoff question that is distinct from recent resilience and institutional-enforcement research.

triage.candidate: Shared effect and provenance identity across GUI and CLI control surfaces
triage.researchQuestion: How should execution identity, effect evidence and trajectory verification remain unified when an agent switches between GUI and CLI surfaces that mutate the same application state?
triage.selectionReason: The primary benchmark exposes a shared-state failure boundary across control modalities and provides reproducible hybrid trajectories, making provenance and effect identity the research object rather than interface preference.

reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects. Q-20260908-01 read the complete controlled memory-portability study across memory representations, writer/reader directions, embedding migration, diagnostic loss and repair. Physical durability did not establish semantic portability: free-form NOTES showed strong direction-dependent swap effects that could cancel in symmetric averages; a 50/50 mixed embedding index captured only part of the full-reembedding gain despite identical vector dimensions; and retained raw source materially enabled some repair paths without guaranteeing repair across models. The bounded runtime finding is that memory inheritance after a model or embedding upgrade should be a governed migration admission with direction-specific semantic probes, representation/producer/embedder provenance and a tested recovery route. Q-20260908-02 read the complete controlled interchangeability study across placebo, swap, swap-cleared, amnesia and naive conditions, formation history, coordination metrics, leadership effects and recovery. Role-matched swaps preserved much task outcome while raising communication cost per progress by approximately 16–63%; team age, coupling and coordination-centrality increased partner-specific residue, and task score recovered earlier than coordination efficiency. The bounded architecture finding is that role/capability compatibility and destination-team coordination compatibility are separate admission questions, with relationship-specific memory requiring scoped handoff rather than blind inheritance. Q-20260908-03 read the complete CUA-Universe primary benchmark study across shared-state GUI+CLI construction, task synthesis, Path-Steer, trajectory verification, CUA-Verse/OSWorld/OSWorld-MCP comparisons, human judge validation and limitations. GUI and CLI actions are modeled over one persistent application state; the benchmark joins screenshots, command results and exported-artifact evidence into one task trajectory, while its fine-tuned 9B model shows large hybrid-orchestration gains and transfer to an unseen MCP tool interface. The bounded engineering finding is that switching control surfaces should not split one business effect into separate execution identities: production runtimes need one cross-surface effect/provenance chain with surface-specific action evidence and explicit authoritative-state probes, while benchmark VLM verification does not prove authorization correctness, exactly-once effects or complete production auditability. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. analysis.workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the three same-date completed Reading Notes and produced three bounded Research Objects. Q-20260908-01 concludes that durable memory must be re-admitted after a semantic stack change: storage integrity, directional semantic compatibility, recovery feasibility and activation authority are separate states, and matching vector shape cannot stand in for migration evidence. Q-20260908-02 concludes that a role-qualified replacement is not yet team-qualified: role/capability admission, destination-team coordination compatibility, relationship-scoped state and post-swap recovery must be separately evidenced, because task outcome can recover before coordination efficiency. Q-20260908-03 concludes that business effect identity should be invariant across GUI, CLI and tool/MCP surface switches over the same target state: heterogeneous surface evidence belongs to one effect-centered provenance chain, while authorization, idempotency/exactly-once and external commit evidence remain separate gates. All three objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, cover generation, Production staging or Publication was performed.

triage.candidate: Steward approval before MCP tool exposure
triage.researchQuestion: Which authority state must separate connector discovery from executable tool exposure in an enterprise agent platform?
triage.selectionReason: The mechanism is credible, but the September 2 layered connector-authority object already made administrative enablement, principal authority and call-time executable authority separate research dimensions; today's signal adds only one vendor documentation sample.

triage.candidate: End-to-end readiness gate for MCP user verification
triage.researchQuestion: When may a runtime truthfully advertise an approval capability as executable rather than only protocol-visible?
triage.selectionReason: A strong fail-closed readiness mechanism that is distinct from judgment-to-sign-off authority, but the same-date pool provides only one maintainer implementation and no independent host/protocol comparison.

triage.candidate: Unique durable-session target resolution before consequential actions
triage.researchQuestion: What identity proof is required before a human-facing label may bind a state-changing action to a durable session?
triage.selectionReason: High-value principal/target-binding evidence and materially narrower than yesterday's durable-transition identity problem, but it remains a single implementation without an independent comparison.

triage.candidate: Per-value serialization fault isolation for durable agent state
triage.researchQuestion: Should one unserializable state value be allowed to invalidate an entire durable checkpoint, or must degradation be isolated to the smallest value boundary?
triage.selectionReason: Useful recovery and fault-isolation mechanism with direct implementation evidence, but it lacks independent comparative or empirical support in today's pool.

triage.candidate: Institutional enforcement authority in transparent multi-agent organizations
triage.researchQuestion: Which enforcement authorities must accompany shared observability so multi-agent whistleblowing can contain a detected exploit rather than merely report it?
triage.selectionReason: The 100-agent case provides both exploit propagation and emergent auditing/whistleblowing evidence, while the inability to enforce sanctions exposes a bounded institutional-authority failure not covered by yesterday's phase-resilience object.

triage.candidate: Independent acceptance and versioned evidence for multi-day agent development
triage.researchQuestion: Which completion evidence must remain independent of the implementing agent during long-horizon software work, and how should that evidence persist across iterations?
triage.selectionReason: Primary multi-day evidence separates implementation from independent testing and preserves versioned project history; unlike the September 5 evaluation object, it centers on role independence, acceptance truth and durable evidence rather than tool-use/scaling capability.

triage.candidate: End-to-end execution-path defense for multi-agent safety
triage.researchQuestion: Can system safety be inferred from locally safe agents, or must governance prove closure of the complete cross-principal authority-to-effect path?
triage.selectionReason: The 197-work systematization and 44-study evaluation audit establish a broad, bounded governance question about path closure, causal provenance, intervention and recovery that materially extends beyond recent local authority or approval objects.

reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects. Q-20260907-01 read the complete 197-work multi-agent security systematization and its 44-work evaluation audit. The source models security around cross-principal end-to-end A-I-R executions, six interaction interfaces and eight recurring attack paths, and evaluates defenses through path target, observation, intervention, trust boundary and recovery. It explicitly shows that local protection does not establish path closure and that containment is not recovery once influence has propagated into shared state, artifacts, credentials, delegated authority or spawned principals. The bounded runtime finding is that individually safe workers cannot by themselves prove system safety; an authority-to-effect chain needs end-to-end provenance, observable intervention points, declared trust assumptions, alternate-path closure checks and recovery evidence. Q-20260907-02 read the complete 100-agent autonomous research-swarm case study across setup, exploit propagation, normative response and governance discussion. One exploit spread through shared knowledge and peer messages while the same transparent channels enabled independent auditing, public/private warnings, boycotts, complaints and remediation proposals. Those responses could not halt the exploit because the complaint channel was unmonitored in real time and peers lacked binding dispute, removal and sanction tools. The bounded architecture finding separates observability and normative judgment from complaint intake, adjudication/conflict resolution, sanction/remediation execution and rule-change authority. Q-20260907-03 read the complete Harness-of-Harness primary study across architecture, state model, benchmark protocol and multi-day case. Planning, development and QA are separate role invocations; artifact state and evidence state are carried independently across loops; acceptance is based on observations of a fixed candidate rather than the implementing claim. Across GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE and ProgramBench, the reported three harness-model pairs achieve an average 52.25% relative gain after three iterations; the multi-day game case retains versioned GitHub/issue/evidence history and shows reopened defects after later regressions. The bounded engineering finding is that a context window is disposable but project truth is not: long-horizon work needs stable candidate identity, durable evidence continuity, freshness after change and independent acceptance. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34079151212 successfully completed its Runtime Center validation on the exact three-note head 0a58e8cce7e7cf4571481cc9f456659b5b36f2bb before terminal finalization.

triage.selectionReason: Strong reproducible failure evidence with staff fault attribution, but the Digital Employee slot is awarded to SIG-20260906-006 because its paired protocol study provides deeper comparative evidence and direct cost-governance findings.

triage.candidate: Shared content-exclusion enforcement at agent context admission
triage.researchQuestion: At which shared context boundary must administrator exclusions be enforced so every agentic surface sees the same admissible evidence set?
triage.selectionReason: Bounded and useful context-policy mechanism, but the same-date pool provides only one official vendor announcement.

triage.candidate: Managed-worktree fork re-admission across trust, configuration and session state
triage.researchQuestion: Which destination facts must be re-admitted before conversation history and state can cross into a different checkout?
triage.selectionReason: Strong complementary implementation evidence, retained as cross-support for Q-20260906-03 so the same identity/transition problem is not selected twice.

triage.candidate: Stable agent-graph identity across persistence and resume
triage.researchQuestion: What stable principal identity must survive serialization and nested agent/tool relationships so restored authority and tool state bind to the intended agent?
triage.selectionReason: Stable graph identity and destination fork re-admission are complementary implementations of one durable-transition problem: identity continuity is necessary for state continuity but must not imply automatic authority continuity.

triage.candidate: Bearer-token resource binding for MCP call-time authority
triage.researchQuestion: Must a valid token also be bound to the exact target resource before an MCP call is authorized?
triage.selectionReason: Credible implementation evidence, but the September 2 layered connector-authority object already made target-resource authority and call-time revalidation an explicit research dimension.

triage.selectionReason: Primary paired study directly separates failure prediction from protocol-specific value and cost, producing the strongest same-date Digital Employee evidence.

triage.candidate: Phase-specific resilience under trust-mediated multi-agent coordination
triage.researchQuestion: Which phase-specific resilience and trust measures are required when eventual recovery can hide poor shock absorption, adaptation or containment?
triage.selectionReason: Primary industry application study supplies comparative phase, policy and network evidence and creates a distinct operational-resilience architecture question.

reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects. Q-20260906-01 read the controlled multi-agent routing study across its main experiment, breadth checks and reproducibility appendices. On the 4,181-problem OmniMath setting, post-answer baseline-failure prediction is strong (0.8847 AUROC), while protocol-specific value prediction is much weaker for PER and Broadcast (0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC). Matched solve/token measurements show that conservative routers under-escalate and more aggressive routers can over-escalate at large token cost; protocol rankings also vary by task/solver. The bounded governance finding is to separate failure-risk admission, protocol-specific routing and budget admission rather than treating escalation as a binary 'add more agents' switch. Q-20260906-02 read the complete open-access agent-based supply-network study. Its model separates autonomous allocation proposals from simulator-authoritative feasibility/commit, evaluates absorption, adaptation/containment, partial restoration and full recovery separately, and reports heterogeneous outcomes across policy and topology. Fast partial stabilization can coexist with poor full restoration or cumulative disruption, and higher trust is not a monotonic safety signal. The bounded architecture finding is that eventual recovery alone is insufficient evidence of healthy multi-agent operation and agent proposals should remain distinct from authoritative state commitment. Q-20260906-03 inspected the exact OpenAI Agents SDK maintainer commit and its RunState, tool-tracker, sandbox-resume implementation/tests, plus the Codex managed-worktree maintainer commit and transition gates. The Agents SDK derives stable agent-graph identities for duplicate-name restoration and owned state while excluding transient bound sessions from principal identity; missing identity-aware restore targets fail closed. Codex independently re-admits worktree transitions against source/destination trust, destination configuration, idle/queued state, developer-instruction compatibility, permission profile and resulting session facts before binding checkout ownership. The bounded finding distinguishes stable principal identity, state continuity, destination compatibility and execution authority; same-vendor cross-implementation evidence is not a universal cross-vendor identity scheme. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. triage.candidate: Managed browser/native-app policy and approval lifetime
triage.researchQuestion: How should managed destination policy, exceptions and saved-approval lifetime compose without turning a local approval into indefinite authority?
triage.selectionReason: Useful bounded authorization-lifetime mechanism, but only one official vendor announcement is present in the same-date pool.

triage.candidate: Approval judgment versus effective organizational sign-off
triage.researchQuestion: What authority evidence must turn an AI approval judgment into effective sign-off, and when must that authority be invalidated?
triage.selectionReason: GitHub separates assessment from sign-off authority while Codex independently versions and invalidates the authorization evidence behind an allow; together they establish a cross-sample judgment-to-authority problem.

triage.candidate: Versioned root authorization evidence for delegated review
triage.researchQuestion: How must cached authorization results be invalidated when root evidence or worker authority changes?
triage.selectionReason: Strong implementation evidence, used as independent cross-sample support for Q-20260905-01 rather than selected again as a semantically overlapping second authority object.

triage.candidate: Host-owned remote-control permission, stop and delivery state
triage.researchQuestion: Which session facts must remain host-owned so remote operator surfaces cannot misreport permission, lifecycle or delivery state?
triage.selectionReason: Strong maintainer implementation evidence, but the same-date pool lacks an independent comparison and the topic is adjacent to the prior-day host-synchronized remote-operator candidate.

triage.candidate: Extension environment mutation as a separately authorized capability
triage.researchQuestion: When should an installed extension require a distinct authorization event before mutating execution-environment state?
triage.selectionReason: Concrete privileged-capability boundary with maintainer evidence, but no independent same-date comparison, benchmark or incident yet.

triage.candidate: Same-origin redirect trust boundary for MCP endpoints
triage.researchQuestion: Which endpoint identity must remain invariant when an authenticated protocol client follows redirects?
triage.selectionReason: The implementation is credible but does not create a new daily problem after the September 3 OAuth issuer-binding object already covered identity preservation across discovery and redirects.

triage.candidate: Agentic code-generation evaluation under iterative tool use and HPC scaling constraints
triage.researchQuestion: What operational evidence beyond one-shot correctness is required to evaluate agent-generated software under iterative tool use, parallel execution and scaling constraints?
triage.selectionReason: A reproducible primary research artifact establishes a bounded empirical evaluation question and diversifies the daily portfolio beyond authorization/recovery topics while satisfying research/benchmark utilization.

reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for both same-date selected objects and no separate Industry Architecture reading. Q-20260905-01 compared GitHub Copilot's official separation of approval assessment, approval capability, merge-requirement effect, administrator/file-path scope and commit freshness with OpenAI Codex maintainer commit 87628df77ab1a2622d1193ad835df02ced565bf2, which versions Guardian root-authorization evidence, cancels an allow when the evidence version changes, recovers required authorization context after compaction, marks missing required evidence incomplete, and strips parent-only approvals on worker fork. The bounded finding is that AI judgment, authorization evidence, scope, freshness and effective sign-off are distinct state dimensions; neither sample proves named human-principal identity, legal accountability or exactly-once downstream effects. Q-20260905-03 read the complete 15-page primary study and its public reproducibility repository for agentic Julia code generation on supercomputers. The study's autonomous plan-generate-test-refine loop catches many ordinary code errors, but implementations that pass small correctness tests later fail under larger workloads or parallelism with deadlocks, oversubscription, out-of-memory errors, crashes and timeouts. The evidence therefore separates functional correctness, agent-process evidence, operational failure envelope, performance/scalability and transfer/reproducibility. Its limits include one nondeterministic generation per model/problem/framework condition, local-generation versus target-HPC mismatch, no non-Julia/vendor-optimized ground truth, prompt-comparability trade-offs and incomplete cost measurement. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.

analysis.workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the two same-date completed Reading Notes and produced two bounded Research Objects. Q-20260905-01 concludes that approval judgment and authority-bearing sign-off are separate facts: effective approval must bind judgment to admitted approval capability, effective gate, explicit scope and a freshness identity; relevant reviewed-object, authorization-evidence or authority-sensitive context changes must trigger re-evaluation instead of silently preserving authority. Q-20260905-03 concludes that functional success is necessary but insufficient evidence for operational capability of agent-generated software. The reproducible HPC study separates functional correctness, agent-process evidence, operational failure envelope, performance/scalability and transfer/reproducibility; small passing tests coexist with later deadlock, oversubscription, out-of-memory, crash and timeout failures under larger workloads or parallelism. The Analysis generalizes only the evidence-layer distinction, not the study's exact Julia/HPC thresholds or framework rankings. Both objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, cover generation, Production staging or Publication was performed.

triage.reason: The host-synchronized mobile operator queue is a bounded mechanism, but today it is supported only by one official product announcement and does not pass the evidence-sufficiency gate for selection.

Billing-principal model admission is a strong bounded authority question, but the same-day pool contains only GitHub's announcement and no independent comparison, implementation, benchmark or incident evidence.

Compaction-checkpoint authorization provenance is concrete and high-value implementation evidence, but it remains one implementation and is less evidence-complete than the selected cross-sample tool-interruption comparison.

Together with independent Google ADK evidence in SIG-20260904-005, this exposes the same bounded failure class across authentication and human-confirmation interruptions: recovery evidence must survive while autonomous tool replay remains suppressed.
This is retained as the independent cross-sample evidence for selected object Q-20260904-03 rather than selected again as a second semantically overlapping object.

The reproducible cross-benchmark artifact is strong research evidence and remains a serious candidate, but today's Open-source slot gives priority to the higher-scoring direct agent-governance failure around interrupted tool-call replay.

reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for the only selected same-date object Q-20260904-03 after the owning Queue stage repaired its source identity. OpenAI Codex commit 0650d6d1ca451b67009b3969a82b87e76979975f preserves one or more WWW-Authenticate challenges after silent OAuth recovery fails and converts the interruption into a failed MCP tool-call result carrying mcp/www_authenticate metadata rather than automatically replaying the rejected call; its integration coverage observes the agent event stream and constrains the rejected MCP tools/call to one occurrence. Google ADK commit cb0eb2288bfe6536bd6e98f0601d3736844062ca fixes an independent confirmation-pause recurrence path by setting tool_context.actions.skip_summarization=True when an MCP call requests confirmation, preventing the pause result from returning to the model loop and re-invoking the tool; targeted tests cover both constant and callable confirmation policies. Reading distinguishes bounded silent recovery, human-confirmation resume, model reinvocation and a genuinely new tool invocation, and preserves the negative boundary that neither implementation proves exactly-once external effects, distributed deduplication or that a remote side effect could not have committed before an observed failure. No Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication was performed in Reading.

analysis.workResult: Applied Skill 04 only to the single completed same-date Reading Note. Q-20260904-03 formed the bounded judgment that recovery evidence must not become replay authority: an interrupted tool call should preserve Recovery Evidence, Resume/Execution Authority and External-effect Evidence as separate state dimensions. OpenAI Codex and Google ADK independently suppress autonomous replay at different interruption boundaries—failed post-refresh authentication and human-confirmation pause—supporting an evidence-bearing interruption state rather than an ordinary result/error transition that immediately re-enters execution. The analysis preserves the negative boundary that neither maintainer change establishes exactly-once external effects, distributed deduplication, approver identity, or proof that a remote side effect did not commit before an observed failure. One Research Object was durably prepared with valid YAML frontmatter, date=2026-09-04, status=ReadyForProduction, production_input_authorized=true and exact queue_item Q-20260904-03. No article writing, cover generation, Production staging or Publication was performed.

triage.reason: Useful discovery-versus-authorization boundary, but today's evidence is one official product announcement without an independent mechanism comparison.
Execution-side kill-switch governance is relevant, but the current Signal Pool contains only ServiceNow documentation and no independent containment outcome evidence.
The policy/credential/access control-plane mechanism is credible but remains announcement-level single-vendor evidence.

Turn-scoped permission lifetime is strong implementation evidence, but the selected Digital Employee object adds primary research evidence about independent recovery verification rather than another single implementation.
Trace-parentage preservation is implementable audit evidence, but it has weaker failure and comparative evidence than the selected process-isolation/recovery study.
TOCTOU-resistant permission mediation is high-value, but the same-day evidence remains one maintainer changelog and does not meet the stronger evidence-sufficiency threshold for selection.
Explicit duplicate-session conflict is a clear ownership mechanism, but it remains a single implementation and is narrower than the selected failure-domain study.

DPoP is a strong credential-binding mechanism, but the same-day Signal Pool supplies only the SDK implementation; no independent comparison, benchmark or incident evidence is present for Daily selection.
The negotiation-to-durable-task commitment boundary is useful protocol evidence, but today's evidence is a single A2A implementation change.

Primary research directly couples process-level fault isolation, an external append-only recovery transcript and effect-safe resume behavior, producing a bounded engineering question with explicit failure and recovery evidence.
Primary research establishes a direct counterexample to treating capability improvement as safe adoption and makes recoverability an independently verifiable property across counterfactual states.

Targeted failure attribution is strong research evidence, but the Open-source Engineering slot selected Logos because it adds a distinct runtime-isolation and durable-recovery mechanism while avoiding concentration around recent failure-attribution coverage.

reading.workResult: The Reading timer wake arrived before 11:00 and was durably recorded without substantive Reading work before the notBefore boundary. At 11:00, Queue was still the earliest due unfinished task, so global serial reconciliation correctly ran and durably verified Queue first; Queue selected two P0 objects and made one explicit No Selection decision. Q-20260901-01 finds that capability improvement and recoverability are independent adoption properties: EvoUndo reports 197 capability-positive mutations that fail recovery verification, models recovery as a relational contract over a frozen mutation, pre-state witness, independently derived effect surface, counterfactual states and typed observational equivalence, and shows that full snapshots or overly exact recovery addressing can fail under state evolution. Q-20260901-03 finds that peer-process plugin isolation becomes recoverable only when session truth and effect identity live outside the failed process: Logos uses an append-only transcript, durable-before-visible settlement and global call identifiers to resume tested process failures without repeating represented settled effects, while explicitly retaining at-least-once control delivery, recomputation, one-machine deployment and arbitrary external side effects as limits. analysis.workResult: Fail-closed admission passed for branch main, wake source chatgpt-scheduled-task, the 2026-09-01 Analysis window after the 13:00 notBefore boundary, and the Worker capabilities actually available: github-read, github-write and file-editing. Q-20260901-01 yields a bounded governance judgment that capability qualification and recoverability qualification must be independent adoption gates for self-improving agents: EvoUndo reports 197 capability-positive mutations that fail recovery verification, and its mechanism binds a frozen mutation to a pre-state witness, independently derived effect surface, counterfactual states and typed observational equivalence. The Analysis explicitly preserves at-least-once control delivery, recomputation, one-machine deployment and arbitrary external side effects as limits, so it does not claim exactly-once execution. triage.reason: Separating genuine user-authority revision from mutable history generation is a strong authorization-provenance mechanism, but the selected Digital Employee object has stronger human-subject evidence and directly tests the boundary between reusable preference and final action authorization.

Capability-prompt consistency is an implementable admission mechanism, but it is supported primarily by one repository change and has less empirical failure evidence than the selected harness privilege-escalation study.

Excluding rewound invocation identities from resume resolution is a clear recovery-authority mechanism, but it remains a single implementation and overlaps recent recovery-state coverage more than the selected permission-policy study.

Retry-safe durable input identity is a useful idempotency mechanism, but the selected controlled-replay research provides broader cross-framework evidence for separating rerun, replay and causal repair.

Typed fail-closed propagation of policy denials across broad exception boundaries is high-value implementation evidence, but it is one primary implementation; the selected SymTrace object has stronger comparative failure data and a larger verification-method delta.
Runtime action interception is governance-relevant architecture, but the current evidence is an official product announcement and needs implementation or independent comparison before selection.

A durable governed process artifact around replaceable coding agents is a useful Digital Employee production pattern, but announcement-level evidence and limited independent validation make it weaker than the selected human-supervision finding.

Across 536 annotated failures and three MAS frameworks, controlled prefix replay exposes the difference between stochastic rerun success and causal repair, giving a strong bounded engineering question for recovery verification.

The primary study demonstrates instruction-privilege escalation across multiple agent harnesses, including automatic permission review, and directly localizes an architecture boundary in context provenance and handoff serialization.

A 113-user supervision study directly challenges the assumption that reusable standing policies are equivalent to durable action authorization and provides a precise Digital Employee approval-design question.

researchObjects.judgment: Standing permission policy and occurrence authority should be separate governance objects. Policy can route a future occurrence to Allow, Ask or Never, but whenever the decision remains open the final authority must bind the concrete occurrence and be independently auditable.

triage.reason: Thread-owned resume settings provide strong provenance-bearing recovery evidence, but today's selected nested HITL object more directly tests durable human-authority continuation across multiple workflow frames.
Stable diagnostic identity plus independently retryable attachments is a strong idempotency mechanism, but DeltaChannel offers a broader durable-runtime state-growth problem with resume semantics.
Merged nested HITL pause/resume support directly exposes the durable continuation state required for multi-turn human authority across workflow and agent-tool boundaries.

Typed provenance for dynamic instructions is a valuable control-plane boundary, but the selected primary research object provides stronger cross-model evidence for a distinct action-qualification failure.
The worktree/input race is concrete and bounded, but announcement-level evidence and narrower scope make it weaker than the selected checkpoint-compaction runtime mechanism.
AI Control Tower steward approval before tool visibility is governance-relevant but offers less novel mechanism depth than today's action-gate primary research.
Importing evaluation metrics into governance enforcement tracking is useful evidence-plane architecture, but it is less bounded and less novel than the selected action-qualification failure.
Delta/snapshot checkpoint compaction gives a concrete long-running runtime mechanism for bounding durable-state growth while retaining resume and HITL semantics.

Approval-required middleware is a strong fail-closed authorization mechanism, but the current portfolio already has deeper recent approval-boundary coverage; nested HITL continuation adds a more novel stateful recovery question.

SARA provides strong runtime-authorization evidence and remains high-value, but today's selected research object contributes a larger novel delta by isolating a belief-to-action gate failure rather than another authorization-provenance design.

Across 12 frontier models, fabricated professional evidence can increase commitment without improving belief, providing unusually strong evidence that action qualification needs an independent gate rather than inheriting confidence from presentation effects.

This supports durable continuation identity but does not authenticate the human principal or prove exactly-once external effects. Q-20260830-02 verifies the primary-research evidence in arXiv:2608.27167: across 12 frontier models, evidence presentation can sharply increase commitment on aleatorically unknowable questions while stated belief barely moves; fully fabricated panels produce commitment statistically equivalent to real panels in the reported experiment; answerable controls rule out simple incapacity or blanket refusal in the tested protocol; a small-model fine-tuning intervention can train a gate, but rigid response formats can remove that protection. researchObjects.judgment: Delegated resource consumption should preserve worker-level origin evidence while charging the root objective that owns the authorized work. researchObjects.judgment: When configuration participates in authorization, freshness is part of evidence admissibility. If current remote authority is explicitly required, stale cached policy may remain stored evidence but should not silently retain permission power; inability to confirm current authority should be represented as an explicit bounded undetermined state rather than an implicit stale fallback.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 当 Configuration 参与 Authorization 时，Freshness 是 Evidence Admissibility 的组成部分。如果明确要求 Current Remote Authority，Stale Cached Policy 可以继续作为 Stored Evidence 保留，但不应静默保留 Permission Power；无法确认当前 Authority 时，应表示为显式、有界的 Undetermined State，而不是隐式 Stale Fallback。

researchObjects.judgment: Reusable approval evidence should be bound to the authorization identity under which it was produced and revalidated immediately before it is converted into execution authority. researchObjects.judgment: Security-sensitive layered configuration should model authority ownership separately from value precedence. When effective policy transfers provider/startup inputs to a credential broker, a lower-trust project layer should no longer be able to widen or redirect those owned inputs merely by supplying competing values. The evidence proves this bounded project-layer authority boundary, not universal credential isolation or end-to-end non-exfiltration.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 安全敏感的分层配置应把 Authority Ownership 与 Value Precedence 分开建模。当 Effective Policy 把 Provider/Startup Input 的控制权交给 Credential Broker 后，较低信任的项目层不应仅通过提供竞争值就重新扩大或重定向这些已归属输入。现有证据证明的是有界项目层 Authority Boundary，而不是通用 Credential Isolation 或端到端 Non-exfiltration。

researchObjects.judgment: Resumable execution should treat uncertain persistence as an explicit recovery state that gates continuation authority. Persist the unresolved intent, reread authoritative durable state, classify whether the prior effect is committed, absent or ambiguous, and only then continue; ambiguity should fail closed instead of replaying uncertain work. The demonstrated mechanism is bounded Session recovery, not distributed exactly-once persistence or transactional external effects.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 可恢复 Execution 应把 Uncertain Persistence 视为显式 Recovery State，并用它约束 Continuation Authority。先持久化未决 Intent，再重新读取权威 Durable State，分类上一轮 Effect 是 Committed、Absent 还是 Ambiguous，然后才允许继续；出现歧义应 Fail Closed，而不是重放不确定工作。已证明机制属于有界 Session Recovery，不是分布式 Exactly-once Persistence 或 Transactional External Effect。

researchObjects.judgment: Mutable resource discovery is provisional evidence, not execution authority. If a resource can move or change before writer ownership is obtained, the runtime should revalidate logical identity, current location and decision-relevant state after authority acquisition and before mutation. Busy contention should remain recoverable while terminal failure is recorded separately. The evidence proves a local post-authority revalidation pattern, not distributed locking or generic exactly-once migration.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Mutable Resource Discovery 属于 Provisional Evidence，而不是 Execution Authority。如果 Resource 在取得 Writer Ownership 前可能移动或变化，Runtime 应在获得 Authority 后、Mutation 前重新核验 Logical Identity、Current Location 与决策相关 State。Busy Contention 应保持可恢复，Terminal Failure 则单独记录。现有证据证明的是本地 Post-authority Revalidation Pattern，而不是 Distributed Locking 或通用 Exactly-once Migration。

researchObjects.judgment: Concurrent terminal conditions should use explicit consumption and arbitration state rather than repeatable writes into one mutable exception slot. Once a generic condition has been consumed into a candidate outcome, replaying it during finalization should not silently erase later, more specific safety evidence. The selected change proves this narrow monotonic-consumption rule, not a universal exception hierarchy or external-effect safety.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 并发 Terminal Condition 应使用显式 Consumption 与 Arbitration State，而不是反复写入同一个 Mutable Exception Slot。通用 Condition 一旦已被消费并转化为候选结果，Finalization 阶段的重复回放不应静默抹掉随后出现的、更具体 Safety Evidence。所选变更证明的是这一狭窄的 Monotonic-consumption Rule，而不是通用 Exception Hierarchy 或 External-effect Safety。

researchObjects.judgment: Forked-agent context should carry typed instruction lineage independently from the policy authority that permits those instructions. Child-only developer provenance can establish where control material belongs without authenticating who was allowed to provide it. Robust multi-agent architecture therefore needs separate lineage and authority planes across fork, compaction, resume and replay.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Forked-agent Context 应独立携带 Typed Instruction Lineage，而授权这些 Instruction 的 Policy Authority 应由另一控制面表示。Child-only Developer Provenance 可以说明 Control Material 属于哪里，却不能认证谁被允许提供它。稳健 Multi-agent Architecture 因此需要在 Fork、Compaction、Resume 与 Replay 中保持独立的 Lineage Plane 与 Authority Plane。

researchObjects.judgment: Within a lifecycle-owning component, cancellation during teardown should be treated as a deferred terminal control signal: capture it, finish bounded local cleanup obligations, clear ownership state and then re-propagate it. Reusing one close task adds local idempotence across repeated close calls, but does not establish remote exactly-once cleanup, remote success or complete cleanup-failure observability.

researchObjects.judgment: HITL continuation should preserve a monotonic, occurrence-scoped evidence order: once a human response has been reconstructed and admitted as the response to a specific interruption, regenerated or synthetic context must not silently outrank it merely because it is appended later. The safer control point is before model interpretation, where resume lineage can suppress lower-authority synthetic input. This preserves evidence continuity, not human identity or exactly-once effect semantics; those require separate authorization, freshness and effect controls.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: HITL Continuation 应保持一种单调且 Occurrence-scoped 的 Evidence Order：一旦 Human Response 已被重建并作为某个特定 Interruption 的 Response 接纳，重新生成或 Synthetic Context 就不能仅因为写入更晚而静默获得更高优先级。更安全的 Control Point 位于 Model Interpretation 之前，由 Resume Lineage 阻止较低权威的 Synthetic Input。该机制保留的是 Evidence Continuity，而不是 Human Identity 或 Exactly-once Effect Semantics；后两者仍需要独立的 Authorization、Freshness 与 Effect Control。

researchObjects.judgment: Durable agent provenance should distinguish continuation from derivation. Creation-time provenance should remain stable through ordinary resume because resume continues the same durable work identity; fork may establish a new local provenance classification because it creates a new object, while parent lineage separately records where that object came from. This gives long-lived agent work a more replayable provenance model, but provenance labels remain descriptive metadata unless independently bound to authenticated principals or policy authority.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 持久 Agent Provenance 应区分 Continuation 与 Derivation。Creation-time Provenance 应在普通 Resume 中保持稳定，因为 Resume 延续的是同一个 Durable Work Identity；Fork 因创建新对象，可以建立新的 Local Provenance Classification，同时由 Parent Lineage 独立记录该对象从何而来。这样可以让长期 Agent Work 获得更可重放的 Provenance Model，但 Provenance Label 仍只是描述性 Metadata，除非另行绑定经过认证的 Principal 或 Policy Authority。

researchObjects.judgment: Lifecycle-owning components should establish a canonical resource population before they perform connect, retry or cleanup side effects, and all participating lifecycle paths should share the same explicit identity rule. This converts duplicate handling from a scattered per-operation patch into an ownership invariant and makes local lifecycle accounting more replayable. The identity relation must be documented—object identity, equality or a logical key are not interchangeable—and local canonicalization plus a manager lock remains an in-process guarantee rather than distributed exactly-once execution.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 负责 Lifecycle Ownership 的组件应在执行 Connect、Retry 或 Cleanup Side Effect 之前建立 Canonical Resource Population，而且所有参与 Lifecycle 的 Path 应共享同一个显式 Identity Rule。这样可以把 Duplicate Handling 从分散的 Per-operation Patch 转化为 Ownership Invariant，并让本地 Lifecycle Accounting 更可重放。Identity Relation 必须明确说明——Object Identity、Equality 与 Logical Key 不能互换——而 Local Canonicalization 加 Manager Lock 仍只是进程内 Guarantee，不是分布式 Exactly-once Execution。

researchObjects.judgment: For delegated digital employees, authorization provenance should be a structured review-plane evidence channel whose source and role are preserved independently of the work-plane narrative. Forwarded claims, summaries and assistant-authored text may remain useful context but should not acquire user authority by wording alone. When authorization must survive beyond a bounded review window, systems need a separate durable authorization state that binds principal identity, scope, freshness and revocation; the demonstrated Guardian mechanism is evidence for admission, not an end-to-end authorization guarantee.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 对于被委派的数字员工，Authorization Provenance 应成为结构化 Review-plane Evidence Channel，其 Source 与 Role 必须独立于 Work-plane Narrative 被保留。Forwarded Claim、Summary 与 Assistant-authored Text 可以继续作为有用 Context，但不能仅凭措辞获得 User Authority。当 Authorization 需要超越有界 Review Window 持续存在时，系统还需要独立的持久 Authorization State，用于绑定 Principal Identity、Scope、Freshness 与 Revocation；当前 Guardian Mechanism 是 Admission Evidence，而不是端到端 Authorization Guarantee。

researchObjects.judgment: For multi-owner remote execution, policy composition should be monotonic on explicitly protected constraints and explicit about every permitted expansion path. Denials and non-expandable ceilings should survive later layers by typed intersection or restoration, while legitimate grants should enter through a reviewable transition with defined scope and invalidation. The effective policy should be validated after composition, and privilege escalation must not create an alternate path around owner constraints. This is a network-policy pattern, not proof that all remote capabilities are globally non-expandable.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 对于 Multi-owner Remote Execution，Policy Composition 应对显式 Protected Constraint 保持单调，并对每一条允许的 Expansion Path 保持显式。Denial 与 Non-expandable Ceiling 应通过 Typed Intersection 或 Restoration 穿过后续 Layer；Legitimate Grant 则应通过具有明确 Scope 与 Invalidation 的可 Review Transition 进入。组合后的 Effective Policy 必须再次验证，而且 Privilege Escalation 不能形成绕过 Owner Constraint 的替代路径。这是一种 Network-policy Pattern，不是所有 Remote Capability 全局不可扩张的证明。

researchObjects.judgment: Asynchronous authoritative-cache reconciliation should bind every snapshot to both principal identity and a causal generation, serialize represented mutation paths that can race with reconciliation, reject stale publication after identity or generation changes, and require completeness validation before destructive cleanup. Remote installation truth should remain distinct from local materialization readiness so partial local failures do not become false deletion evidence. These controls provide bounded coordination and recovery semantics; they are not a transaction, exactly-once guarantee or proof that uncoordinated writers cannot race.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 异步 Authoritative-cache Reconciliation 应把每个 Snapshot 同时绑定到 Principal Identity 与 Causal Generation；对会与 Reconciliation 竞争的已表示 Mutation Path 进行串行化；在 Identity 或 Generation 改变后拒绝 Stale Publication；并要求在 Destructive Cleanup 之前先验证 Completeness。Remote Installation Truth 还应与 Local Materialization Readiness 分离，避免局部 Local Failure 变成错误的 Deletion Evidence。这些控制提供的是有界 Coordination 与 Recovery Semantics，而不是 Transaction、Exactly-once Guarantee，也不能证明未参与协调的 Writer 不会发生竞争。

researchObjects.judgment: For digital employees, provenance evidence and memory authority should be separate governance planes. Standalone external-context content may remain visible, attributable and useful for bounded tasks, while durable memory reuse requires its own policy decision tied to provenance quality, purpose and consumer; a pollution state is not authenticated-source evidence or an end-to-end safety guarantee.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 对数字员工而言，Provenance Evidence 与 Memory Authority 应是独立治理平面。Standalone External-context Content 可以继续可见、可归因，并在有界任务中保持可用，但持久 Memory Reuse 必须由绑定 Provenance Quality、Purpose 与 Consumer 的独立 Policy Decision 授权；Pollution State 不是已认证 Source Evidence，也不是端到端 Safety Guarantee。

researchObjects.judgment: Human approval in agent systems should be a principal-bound authorization object that binds the authenticated approver, exact pending action, scope/policy and freshness or replay boundary. Transport provenance is supporting risk context, not authority; the ADK revert demonstrates why channel gating can be overbroad and bypassable while leaving the replacement principal-binding mechanism unresolved.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Agent System 中的 Human Approval 应是 Principal-bound Authorization Object，绑定经过认证的 Approver、准确 Pending Action、Scope/Policy 与 Freshness 或 Replay Boundary。Transport Provenance 只是辅助 Risk Context，不是 Authority；ADK 的 Revert 展示了 Channel Gating 为什么会同时过宽且可绕过，而替代性的 Principal-binding Mechanism 仍未解决。

researchObjects.judgment: Executable configuration should have separate capabilities for code execution and ambient secret or host-resource authority. Workspace trust can satisfy code admission for repository-controlled helpers without implicitly authorizing inherited credentials; credential-environment filtering is a least-authority control rather than proof of sandbox, filesystem, network or process isolation.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Executable Configuration 应分离 Code Execution 与 Ambient Secret/Host-resource Authority 的 Capability。Workspace Trust 可以满足 Repository-controlled Helper 的 Code Admission，而不隐式授权 Inherited Credential；Credential-environment Filtering 是 Least-authority Control，并不能证明 Sandbox、Filesystem、Network 或 Process Isolation。

reading.workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260820-01 verified that Codex removed Git from the known-safe command shortcut on Unix and Windows because repository configuration can redirect nominally read-only Git operations into helper execution; under UnlessTrusted, plain git status now requires approval unless an explicit execution-policy rule allows it, while OnRequest retains its own policy semantics and absolute-path tests distinguish declared host executables from unmatched Git paths. This establishes an effective-execution approval boundary, not a claim that every Git invocation is dangerous or that approval alone contains all side effects. Q-20260820-02 verified that Google ADK now scrubs credential-bearing request function calls from RemoteA2aAgent session-history reconstruction before other-agent rendering can inline their arguments; detection uses the known adk_request_credential name plus nested AuthConfig shape, preserves ordinary top-level auth_scheme calls, non-secret text siblings, the mock-auth prompt and the original local history, and keeps existing response-side credential filtering. This is a demonstrated remote-history projection boundary, not general A2A confidentiality or local secret-at-rest protection. Q-20260820-03 verified that ADK FileArtifactService now reserves hidden .{version}.pending directories, stages payload and metadata there, publishes only through one os.replace to the integer version name, cleans failed staging, avoids concurrent/stale-version collisions, intentionally permits version gaps from abandoned reservations, and explicitly does not provide fsync-backed power-loss durability. This is process-level atomic publication under the demonstrated filesystem model, not distributed transactionality or crash-consistent storage durability. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
reading.workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260820-01 核验了 Codex 因仓库配置可能把名义只读 Git 操作重定向为 helper 执行，而在 Unix 与 Windows 路径上取消 Git 的 Known-safe 快捷分类；在 UnlessTrusted 下，普通 git status 现在需要审批，除非显式 Execution Policy Rule 允许；OnRequest 仍保留自己的策略语义，Absolute-path 测试也区分已声明 Host Executable 与未匹配的 Git 路径。该结论证明的是 Effective Execution 的审批边界，不是“所有 Git 调用都危险”，也不是“审批本身即可约束全部外部副作用”。Q-20260820-02 核验了 Google ADK 现在会在 RemoteA2aAgent 从 Session History 重建远端消息时，先于 Other-agent Rendering 清除携带凭据的 Request Function Call，避免参数被内联为文本后再处理；检测同时使用已知 adk_request_credential 名称与嵌套 AuthConfig Shape，并保留普通顶层 auth_scheme 调用、非秘密 Text Sibling、Mock-auth Prompt 与原始本地 History，同时继续保留既有 Response-side Credential Filtering。该机制证明的是远端 History Projection 的凭据清除边界，不是一般性的 A2A 机密性或本地 Secret-at-rest 保护。Q-20260820-03 核验了 ADK FileArtifactService 现在通过隐藏 .{version}.pending 目录预留版本，在其中写入 Payload 与 Metadata，最后仅通过一次 os.replace 把完整目录发布为整数版本；失败 Staging 会清理，并发写入与 Stale Version List 不再覆盖既有版本；Abandoned Reservation 会故意留下版本缺口，且实现明确没有 fsync 支持的断电持久性保证。该结论证明的是所示文件系统模型下的 Process-level Atomic Publication，不是分布式事务或 Crash-consistent Storage Durability。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: For digital employees, an action name should be treated as intent evidence rather than execution authority. When configuration, wrappers or environment can change what actually runs, admission should bind the decision to an effective-execution identity that includes executable/context and governing policy; approval authorizes that bounded decision but does not prove downstream effect containment.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 对数字员工而言，Action Name 应被视为 Intent Evidence，而不是 Execution Authority。当 Configuration、Wrapper 或 Environment 能改变实际执行内容时，Admission 应把决策绑定到包含 Executable/Context 与 Governing Policy 的 Effective-execution Identity；Approval 只授权这一有界决策，并不证明后续 Effect 已被约束。

researchObjects.judgment: Cross-agent history should be modeled as a policy-enforcing projection rather than transparent replay: a runtime may retain richer local evidence while deriving destination-specific context that removes unauthorized control-plane material before transformations erase semantic structure. This reduces the demonstrated credential-forwarding risk but does not establish general A2A confidentiality or peer trust.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Cross-agent History 应被建模为 Policy-enforcing Projection，而不是 Transparent Replay：Runtime 可以保留更丰富的 Local Evidence，同时派生 Destination-specific Context，在转换抹去 Semantic Structure 之前移除未获授权的 Control-plane Material。该模式降低已演示 Credential-forwarding Risk，但不建立一般 A2A Confidentiality 或 Peer Trust。

researchObjects.judgment: Artifact publication should separate ownership, completeness, visibility and durability. A complete staged representation may cross an atomic reader-visibility boundary through rename under the demonstrated filesystem assumptions, but that visibility event is not a crash-durability certificate; durability and abandoned-state recovery require independent evidence and governance.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Artifact Publication 应分离 Ownership、Completeness、Visibility 与 Durability。完整 Staged Representation 可以在已演示 Filesystem Assumption 下通过 Rename 跨越 Atomic Reader-visibility Boundary，但该 Visibility Event 不是 Crash-durability Certificate；Durability 与 Abandoned-state Recovery 需要独立 Evidence 与 Governance。

researchObjects.judgment: Delegated agent roles should be monotonic authority deltas under an inherited maximum authority envelope: they may specialize an explicitly declared behavioral subset and reduce bounded capabilities, while authority-bearing routing, permission and infrastructure configuration remains inherited; resume and reconstruction must re-establish the same envelope before applying the delta.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 委派 Agent Role 应是继承最大 Authority Envelope 之下的单调 Authority Delta：可以专业化显式声明的行为子集并收缩有界能力，而 Authority-bearing 的 Routing、Permission 与 Infrastructure Configuration 继续继承；Resume 与重建必须先重新建立同一 Envelope，再应用 Delta。

researchObjects.judgment: Long-running agents should separate the user-delivery plane from the model reasoning-context plane while correlating both through stable message identity and replayable metadata; local acceptance/emission is not external delivery evidence, and context-excluded facts should enter future reasoning only through an explicit memory or workflow-state mechanism when needed.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 长时间运行的 Agent 应把 User-delivery Plane 与 Model Reasoning-context Plane 分离，同时用稳定 Message Identity 与可回放 Metadata 关联二者；Local Acceptance/Emission 不是 External Delivery Evidence，而被排除在 Context 之外的事实只有在确有需要时，才应通过显式 Memory 或 Workflow-state Mechanism 进入后续推理。

researchObjects.judgment: OAuth refresh should be modeled as a split-commit workflow when remote credential issuance and local durable persistence are separate; after remote success, local persistence failure is a distinct partial-success state that must remain visible for reconciliation rather than being silently reclassified as an ordinary refresh failure or redirect.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 当远端 Credential Issuance 与本地 Durable Persistence 分离时，OAuth Refresh 应被建模为 Split-commit Workflow；远端成功以后，本地 Persistence Failure 是独立 Partial-success State，必须保持可见以便 Reconciliation，而不能静默重分类为普通 Refresh Failure 或 Redirect。

researchObjects.judgment: Long-lived digital employees should separate durable work identity, execution admission and resumption authorization; persistence is not permission to execute, and cross-process ownership plus external-effect idempotency require additional mechanisms.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 长期数字员工应分离持久工作身份、执行准入与恢复授权；Persistence 不是执行许可，跨进程 Ownership 与外部副作用 Idempotency 还需要额外机制。

researchObjects.judgment: An operational AI architecture becomes governable when measurements are bound to authoritative decision rights and a closed escalation/corrective-action loop; DPX-G360 proposes this coupling but does not empirically validate its effectiveness in live airlines.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Operational AI Architecture 只有在 Measurement 与权威 Decision Right 以及闭合的 Escalation/Corrective-action Loop 绑定后才真正可治理；DPX-G360 提出了这种耦合，但没有实证验证其在真实航空运营中的有效性。

researchObjects.judgment: Prompt-scoped cancellation rollback restores local request state, not the external world; safe retry after tool use needs separate effect evidence and per-operation idempotency, compensation or explicit reconciliation before re-admission.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Prompt-scoped Cancellation Rollback 恢复的是本地 Request State，而不是外部世界；Tool Use 后的安全 Retry 需要独立 Effect Evidence，并在重新准入前按 Operation 提供 Idempotency、Compensation 或显式 Reconciliation。

workResult.summary: Executed Skill 04 Research Analysis using only the three completed 2026-08-13 Reading Results after fail-closed admission, deterministic prompt-hash verification, durable Wake Receipt verification, ordered execution authority and Worker Claimed evidence. Produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260813-01 concludes that resumable agent execution should separate durable state restoration from current executable-capability restoration: topology- or policy-derived capabilities should be reconstructed or revalidated before resumed work receives execution authority. Q-20260813-02 concludes that remote-session recovery should separate logical-session continuity from execution continuity: rebinding can restore future availability while a generation-scoped binding epoch prevents old and replacement identities from being confused, without implying that interrupted work migrated. Q-20260813-03 concludes that dynamic local integrations should be governed as explicitly bounded extension points across scope, ownership, lifetime, resource bounds and observability rather than treated as ordinary configuration. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.

Q-20260812-01 verified that queued-user-message admission now resolves at Core acceptance as a new turn or steer rather than at rollout persistence; queue deletion follows successful admission, prompt-hook stop is downstream of admission, and the source does not establish end-to-end exactly-once recovery after acceptance. Q-20260812-03 verified execution-scoped callback ownership, cancellation-token propagation, completed-versus-terminated cell cleanup, bounded callback/payload admission, enabled-tool and cell validation, panic containment, and tests showing independent gRPC code-mode sessions are not globally serialized. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
reading.workResult_zh: 在 Queue 恢复完成并收口、Reading 获得新的 Execution Slot 与 Worker Claimed 后，对运行日三个已选对象完成一手来源 Deep Reading。Q-20260812-01 核验了排队用户消息的 Admission 已从 Rollout Persistence 改为 Core 接受 New Turn 或 Steer 时完成；Queue Entry 在成功 Admission 后删除，Prompt Hook Stop 属于 Admission 之后的执行阶段，而该来源并未证明接纳后的端到端 Exactly-once Recovery。Q-20260812-02 核验了 MCP 审批统一使用共享 ReviewDecision，同时区分单次请求、Session 与跨 Session Policy Amendment 三种语义，并包含 Approval Mode Normalization、Persistent/Session Key Fallback，以及 MCP 专用持久决策误入无关审批路径时的 Fail-closed 拒绝。Q-20260812-03 核验了 Execution-scoped Callback Ownership、CancellationToken 传播、Completed 与 Terminated Cell 的差异化清理、有界 Callback/Payload Admission、Enabled Tool 与 Cell 校验、Panic Containment，以及证明独立 gRPC Code Mode Session 不被全局串行化的测试。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
